Introduction

Dayeon is a South Korean dancer, singer, and rapper currently signed to Jellyfish Entertainment. She is best known as a member of the South Korean girl group Kep1er, formed through the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999.

Dayeon first gained attention in 2018 when she participated in Mnet's Produce 48. Despite showcasing her skills, she was eliminated in the fifth episode, placing 70th overall.

In 2021, Dayeon returned to the survival show scene by joining Girls Planet 999, where she represented the K-Group. She performed a cover of "Pop/Stars" by K/DA for her evaluation, though she was not initially selected as a TOP9 candidate. Throughout the competition, Dayeon consistently ranked highly, finishing in 4th place during the finale with 885,286 points and 219,125 votes, securing her spot as a member of Kep1er.

On January 3, 2022, Dayeon officially debuted as a member of Kep1er with their first mini-album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The group’s debut was well-received, marking the beginning of Dayeon’s active career in the kpop industry.
